speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; bronchiectasis typically affects the lungs, not the head. Given the throbbing pain behind your eyes and the flashing lights, are you experiencing nausea or sensitivity to bright light as well? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_with_contrast

text: RESULTS: MRI_Brain_with_contrast: Evidence of increased intracranial pressure with signs compatible with idiopathic intracranial hypertension. No masses or lesions observed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri). The MRI confirms elevated intracranial pressure without a mass, which explains your severe headache, visual disturbances, and the fact that your lung condition (bronchiectasis) is unrelated to these neurological symptoms. I will need to check your visual fields and measure your opening pressure via lumbar puncture to confirm the diagnosis and prevent permanent vision loss.
